explanation: Because it follows the equinox, the new year can arrive at any hour, even in the middle of the night. Families set a haft-sin table of seven items whose Persian names start with 's'.

claims.text: Nowruz, the Persian New Year, begins at the moment of the March equinox.
Nowruz does not begin at the December solstice, at the June solstice or at a new moon.
Because Nowruz begins at the moment of the equinox, the new year can begin at any hour of the day or night.
The haft-sin table holds seven items whose Persian names begin with the letter sin ('s').
